nodes.label: Dataset Schedule (Training, Validation, Test & 673 Forecast Origins)
nodes.norm_label: dataset schedule (training, validation, test & 673 forecast origins)
nodes.rationale: Data spans 1 Jun – 2 Nov 2026; training cut-off is 4 Oct 2026, validation period is 7 Sep – 4 Oct 2026 (actuals_validation.csv), and test period is 5 Oct – 1 Nov 2026 (673 hourly origins x 40 steps = 26,920 rows).

nodes.label: Long-Format Input Schema (inputs.parquet, spot_nordpool.csv, availability.csv)
nodes.rationale: Each row has series_id, source, dataset_id, timestamp_utc, value, unit, and binding first_usable_origin_utc computed from availability.csv.

nodes.label: Level 2 Situational Dashboard & Time Machine
nodes.rationale: Provides visual alerts when p_spike_high > 0.3 or p_spike_low > 0.3 and a Time Machine slider to inspect historical forecast origins.

nodes.label: Rule #3: Submission File Integrity (forecast_backtest.csv)
nodes.rationale: Final submission file must contain exactly 26,920 rows (673 origins x 40 steps) and pass validate_submission.py.

nodes.label: SHAP Explainability (top_drivers)
nodes.rationale: Uses shap.TreeExplainer on LightGBM models to populate semicolon-separated top_drivers explaining forecast factors.

nodes.label: Level 1 Deliverable: 10-Hour Probabilistic Forecast (80% Weight)
nodes.rationale: Requires 15-minute resolution over 10 hours (40 steps): point forecast p50 (30%), uncertainty interval p10-p90 (20%), spike probabilities >50 EUR/MWh from spot (20%), balancing direction (10%), and reasoning chain (20%).

nodes.label: Turku Energia (Challenge Partner)
nodes.rationale: Plans electricity procurement, trading, and flexible asset operation; needs 10-hour imbalance price visibility to manage imbalance risk and reserve market offers.

nodes.label: Darts Time-Series Library (u8darts)
nodes.rationale: Unifies statistical models (ARIMA, Exponential Smoothing) and machine learning/deep learning models (N-BEATS) under one API.

nodes.label: Feature Matrix X (Future Target Features + Real-Time Lag Features)
nodes.norm_label: feature matrix x (future target features + real-time lag features)
nodes.rationale: Combines future delivery-time features (spot_price_target, wind/solar/consumption DA forecasts, residual_load_forecast) with origin-time lag features (last_imbalance_price, last_mfrr/afrr volumes, consumption_forecast_error, net_cross_border_flow).

nodes.label: Six LightGBM Model Suite (3x Quantile, 1x Multiclass, 2x Binary)
nodes.norm_label: six lightgbm model suite (3x quantile, 1x multiclass, 2x binary)
nodes.rationale: Trains 3 quantile regressors (p10, p50, p90), 1 multiclass classifier (p_up, p_down, p_none), and 2 binary classifiers (p_spike_high, p_spike_low) over the 40-step feature matrix X.

nodes.label: Official Persistence Baseline (baseline.ipynb)
nodes.rationale: Sets p50 to the latest usable imbalance price at origin across all 40 steps, p10/p90 from historical persistence error quantiles, and direction/spike probabilities from historical shares.

nodes.label: Core ML & Data Science Stack (pandas, numpy, lightgbm, shap, scikit-learn, pyarrow)
nodes.norm_label: core ml & data science stack (pandas, numpy, lightgbm, shap, scikit-learn, pyarrow)
nodes.rationale: Defines required Python 3.11+ package versions for dataset building, LightGBM quantile/classification models, SHAP explainability, and submission validation/scoring.

nodes.label: Rule #1: Data Availability (first_usable_origin_utc)
nodes.rationale: At forecast origin t, models must only use rows where first_usable_origin_utc <= t; any future data leakage causes an automatic evaluation score of 0.

nodes.label: Rule #2: Nord Pool Spot Price Licensing (spot_nordpool.csv)
nodes.norm_label: rule #2: nord pool spot price licensing (spot_nordpool.csv)
nodes.rationale: data/spot_nordpool.csv is licensed exclusively for Turku Energia hackathon participants and must never be committed to public repositories.

nodes.label: Prediction Post-Processing Constraints
nodes.rationale: Enforces quantile monotonicity (p10 <= p50 <= p90), direction probability simplex (p_up + p_down + p_none == 1.0), and spike probability bound (p_spike_high + p_spike_low <= 1.0).

nodes.label: rows_available_at(origin_utc) Anti-Leakage Helper
nodes.rationale: Mandatory filter ensuring only rows with first_usable_origin_utc <= origin_utc are used to prevent future data leakage and an automatic score of 0.

nodes.label: Imbalance Price Formation (mFRR & aFRR)
nodes.rationale: Dominant balancing direction is set by mFRR activations (Fingrid 369); since 1 June 2026, when mFRR and aFRR align in the dominant direction, price is their volume-weighted average, otherwise based on Nord Pool day-ahead spot price when direction is none.

nodes.label: Level 2 Deliverable: Situational Overview & Decision Support (20% Weight)
nodes.norm_label: level 2 deliverable: situational overview & decision support (20% weight)
nodes.rationale: Surfaces actionable alerts and historical review for shift supervisors and energy traders without issuing automated plant dispatch commands because internal plant marginal costs and heat constraints are not in open data.

nodes.label: Probabilistic Forecasting & Explainable AI for Human Traders
nodes.norm_label: probabilistic forecasting & explainable ai for human traders
nodes.rationale: Traditional point forecasts are insufficient; traders need calibrated uncertainty intervals, spike probabilities, and transparent XAI decision support rather than black-box automated trading.

nodes.label: Imbalance Spread Forecasting Strategy (Delta P = Imbalance - Spot)
nodes.norm_label: imbalance spread forecasting strategy (delta p = imbalance - spot)
nodes.rationale: Because imbalance price equals spot price when mFRR direction is none and spikes are defined relative to spot +/- 50 EUR/MWh, anchoring on spot_price_target or predicting the spread Delta P directly beats the 66.20 EUR/MWh baseline MAE.

nodes.label: 24-Hour Timeline & Publication Lag Causality
nodes.rationale: Day-ahead forecasts (D-1 13:00) and Nord Pool spot prices (D-1 14:00) act as legal future features for steps 1..40, while real-time consumption/flows (30m lag) and imbalance/mFRR/aFRR (60m lag) act as current grid stress indicators.

nodes.label: Checkpoints, Sessions & Trails
nodes.rationale: Git ref checkpoints and session trails explain why code lines exist and coordinate multi-developer agent workflows.

nodes.label: Entire.io CLI (entire)
nodes.rationale: Tracks agent sessions, Git ref checkpoints, trails, and recaps across the 4-developer team using Antigravity hooks.

nodes.label: Official Scoring & Points Formula (score.py)
nodes.rationale: Total score = 0.8 * Level 1 + 0.2 * Level 2; automatic sub-criteria points = weight * clip((B - T) / (B - best), 0, 1) comparing team metric T against persistence baseline B and best submission.

nodes.label: Starter Package Open & Licensed Data Sources (Fingrid, ENTSO-E, Nord Pool, FMI)
nodes.norm_label: starter package open & licensed data sources (fingrid, entso-e, nord pool, fmi)
nodes.rationale: Combines Fingrid Open Data (CC BY 4.0), ENTSO-E Transparency Platform (CC BY 4.0), licensed Nord Pool spot prices, and calendar data.
